g.text: QRWTY | what happens when something fails
PROPOSED — cache validity and analytics loss are explicit contracts, not hidden implementation details.
Solid arrow: request / read Dashed arrow: queued delivery Amber: product rule
Fresh hit: use it. Copying an entry never extends its original deadline.
Blocked / deleted / expired: no redirect; return the defined public error.
Never serve beyond the original validity/expiry bound to hide a database outage.
If every click must be durable, change the latency, availability and cost contract before building.
